svg.title: RSIHub architecture
svg.desc: An evolution driver on the left, where a recipe-driven evolve.yaml names the target seed, the mutable surface, one operator per stage, the evaluator, and the train, gate, and sealed splits, and writes to a verified archive of parent commits, evaluation records, and artifacts. In the center, the evolution loop runs around a candidate: select a parent, roll out on train tasks, analyze to distill evidence, mutate the candidate, check boundaries at the guardrail, evaluate to score and certify, then absorb by recording and admitting. Select, rollout, analyze, mutate, and absorb are recipe policy stages; guardrail and evaluate are framework-controlled. On the right, a protected runtime holds the Harbor executor, the frozen evaluation and its splits, and the workspace layout of evolve.yaml, operator, target, evaluator, runs, and archive.jsonl.
